annotator_notes: 生成方式：据 source sha256=f48476156888967b2ff380a27d6c7b745995394ff73708c3849bb3180459e7d1（标题《How to Build an Obsidian Dashboard That Shows You Everything That Matters Today》）做 paraphrase。
